svg.title: How the kaltinril/everquest-companion project is run (one trunk, since 2026-10-26)
svg.desc: main_community is the trunk: every change is a short-lived work branch off it, in a temporary worktree, gated, merged back, then removed. A community-version tag on main_community builds a GitHub Release. The original repo, jmoyers/everquest-companion, is a frozen reference: it is no longer active, main is a frozen copy of its main, nothing is synced, and its code is taken only on the owner's word, after a full read. The old feature branches are retired and kept for history.
svg.text: kaltinril/everquest-companion: how the project is run
One trunk, main_community, since 2026-10-26: short-lived work branches merge into it behind the gate
House rules (docs/community/RULES.md)
• Every change: a work branch off main_community.
• Outside code is read whole before it merges.
• Releases only on the owner's word.
• main is a frozen copy, never committed to.
• Push to origin only, never to upstream.
The original repo
jmoyers/everquest-companion (upstream):
no longer active; main is a frozen copy;
nothing synced; its code is taken only on the
owner's word, after a full read
The trunk
main_community
the default branch: the dev app runs it, every build comes from it
Gate on the work branch and again after the merge:
typecheck, lint, npm test on Node 24; cargo test for engine changes; only the known reds may fail
Work branches: one job each, then gone
a feature or a fix
a data refresh
a version bump with tester notes
git worktree add -b <name> .claude/worktrees/<name> main_community
gate, merge into main_community, then remove the worktree (junction first) and the branch
branch off
gate, then merge back
A release
community-<version>
tag on main_community, owner's word only,
after the pack compare and a delta scrape;
GitHub Actions builds and publishes it
Retired branches
the old feature branches, catch_all,
the never-closing branches, community/pr-*:
merged in, marked RETIRED.md (2026-10-26),
kept for history, never merged again
One fix, start to finish: worktree and branch off main_community → change → gate → merge → gate again → owner tests → push main_community to origin → remove worktree and branch
docs/community/README.md explains each step; RULES.md binds them
